verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents MCP support only as a client-side integration—agents can use the `mcps` field to consume external MCP servers/tools—but there is no evidence CrewAI itself exposes an official MCP server that other agents could connect to. The framework/platform nature makes this a fair axis to ask about, but no first-party or independent evidence shows an official CrewAI-hosted MCP server endpoint.
